description: Rules-based mapping connecting victim case types, distress levels, and psychological factors to evidence-backed interventions.
compliance_disclaimer: All interventions are advisory recommendations for counsellors and officials. No automated actions are executed without human verification.

rules.title: Immediate Threat Assessment & Police Escort
rules.description: Deploy local Special Cell / Police Protection Unit to assess physical perimeter security and provide trial appearance escorts under the Witness Protection Scheme.
rules.recommended_authority: District Superintendent of Police / Witness Protection Cell

rules.title: Crisis Intervention & Emergency Trauma De-escalation
rules.description: Initiate an emergency tele-counselling or in-person trauma de-escalation session within 24 hours to stabilize acute panic and suicidal ideation risk.
rules.recommended_authority: District Mental Health Programme (DMHP) / Empanelled Clinical Psychologist

rules.title: Safe House / Short-Stay Shelter Allocation
rules.description: Provide confidential temporary relocation to a secure government safe home, One Stop Centre (OSC), or institutional rehabilitation facility.
rules.recommended_authority: District Social Welfare Officer / One Stop Centre (OSC)

rules.title: Comprehensive Medical Referral & Psychiatric Evaluation
rules.description: Arrange priority clinical evaluation at the District Civil Hospital for trauma-induced somatic symptoms, sleep disturbance, physical injuries, or psychiatric medication review.
rules.recommended_authority: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) / District Civil Hospital

rules.title: Interim Victim Compensation & Relief Disbursement
rules.description: Expedite release of mandatory 25-50% first-stage interim financial relief under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Rules or State Victim Compensation Scheme.

rules.title: Pro Bono Legal Aid & Fast-Track Court Counsel
rules.description: Assign a designated DLSA retainer advocate to file witness protection petitions, review court summons, and represent the victim in fast-track trial proceedings.

rules.title: Weekly Structured Supportive Psychotherapy
rules.description: Schedule structured weekly counselling sessions focused on cognitive resilience, anxiety coping strategies, and trauma recovery stabilization.

rules.title: Trial Hearing Notifications & Legal Progress Briefing
rules.description: Provide regular SMS/portal status briefings regarding charge-sheet progress, court appearance dates, and legal aid rights.

rules.title: Routine Multi-Channel Wellness Check-in
rules.description: Maintain regular bi-weekly automated check-ins via chatbot, SMS, or helpline IVRS with counsellor escalation triggered automatically on score shifts.
